Your State Pension summary
A N OTHER
You can get your State
Pension on 1 March 2058
Your forecast is £200.00 a week,
£869.05 a month, £10,428.57 a year
Your forecast
is not a guarantee and is based on the current law
is based on your National Insurance record up to 5 April 2026
assumes that you’ll contribute another 20 years
does not include any increase due to inflation
You currently have 15 years on your record and you need at least 10 years to
get any State Pension.
